title.zh: 此修复工具适用于WWMI生产的Mod因游戏版本更新导致失效的情况
title.en: This fix tool is applicable when the mods produced by WWMI become ineffective due to the update of the game version.

intro.zh:
修复更新: 请将XXMI更新至最新版本
* 修复主角及其表情（注意：若此前手动修改过 Hash，请先回滚或还原才能触发修复）
* 修复千咲皮肤和景燃
* 纠正莫宁 Component3 Materialmap hash 的错误引用（建议回滚后重新修复）
intro.en:
Fix Update: Please update XXMI to the latest version.
* Fixed Rover and their expressions (Note: If you have manually modified hashes before, please rollback or restore first to trigger this fix)
* Fixed Chisa outfit and Jingran
* Corrected Mornye Component3 Materialmap hash reference (it is recommended to roll back and re-fix)

intro_note.zh:
**游戏资源与 Engine.ini 设置说明：**
1. **客户端资源质量**：游戏 3.7 版本起将包体资源质量划分为 `SD` / `HD` / `UHD`，当前 Mod 基本运行在 `HD` 下。请在 XXMI「设置/通用/游戏设置/客户端资源质量」中将其设为 **HD**（无需再手动添加启动项 `-krqlv=hd`）。
2. **Engine.ini 配置**：请在 `Engine.ini` 的 `[SystemSettings]` 下添加以下配置以保证 Mod 贴图正常流送加载：
   ```ini
   [SystemSettings]
   r.Streaming.UsingNewKuroStreaming=0
   r.Streaming.HiddenPrimitiveScale=25
   ```
   *注：若切人时遇到贴图延迟加载，可酌情尝试追加 `r.Streaming.FramesForFullUpdate=0`（非必须项，可能带来额外性能损失或副作用，请按需权衡）。*
intro_note.en:
**Game Resources & Engine.ini Settings Requirements:**
1. **Client Resource Quality**: Starting from game version 3.7, package resource quality is divided into `SD` / `HD` / `UHD`. Currently, mods basically run under `HD`. Please set "Settings / General / Game Settings / Client Resource Quality" to **HD** in XXMI (no longer need to manually add launch parameter `-krqlv=hd`).
2. **Engine.ini Configuration**: Please add the following configuration under `[SystemSettings]` in `Engine.ini` to ensure normal texture streaming:
   ```ini
   [SystemSettings]
   r.Streaming.UsingNewKuroStreaming=0
   r.Streaming.HiddenPrimitiveScale=25
   ```
   *Note: If you experience texture streaming delays during character switching, you may optionally try adding `r.Streaming.FramesForFullUpdate=0` (not required, may introduce extra performance overhead or side effects, use at your discretion).*
